worldcombat.skill.sandstorm.summary: Whip the ground into a sand curtain with a fixed wind: gusts sweep across it in lanes, only bodies inside the current lane with no cover upwind are ground down and pushed downwind, Rock bodies harden their Sp. Def, and the ground keeps only sand traces.
worldcombat.skill.sandstorm.use.0: Suppress foes without a stone body
worldcombat.skill.sandstorm.use.1: Grind a crowd inside the curtain
worldcombat.skill.sandstorm.use.2: Harden Rock bodies and shove formations downwind
Press a sandstorm of radius %1$s blocks onto the chosen ground for %2$s; the covered area counts as sandstorm weather and its sunlight is dimmed.

Each pass the storm drives a lane %1$s blocks wide along the wind: a body inside the current lane with no solid cover upwind, unless Rock, Ground or Steel, is ground for %2$s of its max health (at least 1) and pushed %3$s blocks downwind; Rock bodies are not scoured, instead gaining one Sp. Def stage from the grit, returned when they leave the storm.

After leaving, the clung sand stays for about %1$s, during which the body still counts as being in the sandstorm; the storm grinds once every %2$s. The ground keeps only a sand trace, with no blocks placed.
Starts up in %1$s and settles in %2$s, both driven by Speed.
The wind is fixed at cast to the horizontal direction from caster to landing point; each pass drives %1$s blocks along it, and stepping into the lee of cover keeps a body unscoured.
worldcombat.skill.sandstorm.timing: Cast at ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to raise the storm, recovers %3$s, and commits a %5$s cooldown on cast.
worldcombat.skill.sandstorm.growth.0: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sandstorm.growth.1: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sandstorm.preference.a: On = abrasive: wider curtain (x1.15), wider lane (x1.25), faster advance (x1.2), harder scour (x1.3), stronger drift (x1.35), faster passes (interval x0.82) and longer clung sand (x1.3), but shorter life (x0.78) and cooldown +16 ticks. Off = mild cover: radius x0.9, lane x0.8, advance x0.85, scour x0.8, drift x0.8, pass interval x1.18 and clung sand x0.85, but lasts longer (x1.22) and cools down 10 ticks sooner.
The companion only raises a sandstorm while a threat is within this distance; lower raises it up close, higher sets it up in advance.
Push the curtain at the foe
On, the curtain is raised between you and the threat, closer to the threat, so the wind runs down the enemy corridor; off, it is raised at your feet to shield yourself first.
On, the companion will not raise the storm here if a non-Rock/Ground/Steel ally already lies in its downwind corridor; off, it drops the sand on them too.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to raise sand.
